integrity: The proof derives quotient layer sizes from the chain-ring filtration, identifies the universal lifted socle and a valuation-one witness whose open neighborhood is exactly that lift, then counts all total dominating sets and classifies minimum paired sets. Direct multiplication-table examples independently replay the formulas.
scientific_limitations: The quotient R/I is required to be a finite chain ring; higher-dimensional socles can destroy the unique neighborhood used in the classification.
The numerical value gamma_t=2 in the nonisolated chain-ring case is not claimed as new because prior work proves total-domination-number transfer from Gamma_I(R) to Gamma(R/I).
The total-domination polynomial of ordinary zero-divisor graphs of Z/(p^alpha) is prior coverage of a special I=0 subfamily.
The finite computational replay is corroborative only.
title: Total-domination polynomial and paired minima for ideal-based graphs over chain quotients
